title: SOC Lead / SOC Manager
summary: A SOC lead runs the security operations centre, the team that watches for and responds to attacks around the clock. They manage L1 and L2 analysts and shift rosters, own major incidents and report to senior management.
dailyDuties: Run shift rosters and coach L1 and L2 analysts
Lead major incidents and own the incident response plan
Plan the detection roadmap and SIEM coverage against MITRE ATT&CK
Drive SOAR automation to cut alert fatigue
Track SLA and risk metrics and report them to leadership
Meet RBI, CERT-In and ISO 27001 reporting duties
Work with IT, legal and business owners during incidents

skills.expectation: Run major incidents and own the incident response plan

Measure detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK
Run shift rosters, hire and coach L1 and L2 analysts
Drive automation to cut alert fatigue
Report security risk and SLA metrics to leadership
Meet RBI, CERT-In and ISO 27001 reporting duties

Present incident reports to senior management
